name: book_meeting
title: Book or move a meeting
description:
Book a meeting for a conversation's customer at `datetime` (e.g. "2026-11-04 10:30",
workspace time), or move their existing one (`meeting_id` from `list_meetings`). A time
outside the booking rules needs `outside_rules_ok: true`; a time that clashes with another
meeting is always refused. Booking does not tell the customer.

meeting_id.description: Move this meeting instead of booking a new one.

outside_rules_ok.description: The person agreed to a time outside the booking rules.
